transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I feel like I’ve lost the drive to do anything or be around people. It's just getting harder and harder to talk or care about things the way I used to.
How long have you been feeling this way, and have you experienced similar episodes like this in the past?

It started right after I graduated high school, so it's been going on for a little over two years now. It hasn't really been separate episodes, just this slow, continuous shutting down that has kept getting worse.
Do you ever feel like you have special, unusual ways of thinking, or do you sometimes feel like people are talking about you or that you have a unique connection to events around you?

Yes, actually, over the last couple of months I've noticed that the ladies at my church and the nurses at the clinic seem to be checking up on me. When they pause their conversations or glance over at me, I can tell they're talking in code because they've been told to keep an eye on me. It's a really strange feeling, but I'm pretty sure it's happening.
Have you ever experienced periods where you heard voices that others couldn't hear, or have these concerns about people talking about you been your primary focus?

No, I've never heard any voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear. My main concern has just been that feeling that the people at church and the clinic are watching me and talking in code, which I only started noticing in the last couple of months.
Besides these thoughts about being watched, have you noticed any other changes, such as your speech becoming disorganized or your behavior becoming noticeably erratic or unusual to others?

No, my speech doesn't feel disorganized, but I feel blank inside and my words just come out very short and flat now. My behavior isn't wild or erratic, but I've become extremely withdrawn and mostly just sit and stare in my room or the garden. My family really noticed when I completely stopped going to church and withdrew from my usual activities.

Besides the feeling of being watched, have you noticed any other changes, such as a significant decline in your ability to take care of your personal hygiene or a loss of interest in almost all daily activities?

Yes, I've lost interest in almost everything and spend most of my days just sitting in my room or by the garden staring. My hygiene is okay, but I feel completely blank inside and can't motivate myself to apply for jobs or go to church. I just don't have the drive to do anything else.

When you have these thoughts about people watching you or talking in code, do you feel like these ideas are based on actual events you've witnessed, or do you feel like they are a fixed belief that you are certain is true despite what others might say?

I feel like it's based on actual things I see happening, like when the ladies at church or the nurses at the clinic suddenly stop talking and glance over at me. I know it probably sounds strange to other people, but seeing them do that makes me certain they are keeping an eye on me and communicating in code.

Besides the suspicion that people are watching you, have you ever experienced any other unusual beliefs, such as feeling that you have a special mission, that you are being controlled by an outside force, or that you have special powers?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I don't feel like I have any special powers or missions, and I don't feel controlled by anyone else.

Has there ever been a period of at least a month where you experienced these suspicious thoughts about people watching you, but without the persistent 'blank' feeling and loss of drive that you've been describing?

No, there has never been a time like that. The shut down and blank feelings have been constant for over two years now, while the suspicious thoughts only started a couple of months ago. So those thoughts have only ever happened while I was already feeling this way.
Have you ever experienced any periods of disorganized speech, or have you noticed your thoughts becoming so muddled that others have difficulty following what you are saying?

No, I haven't really experienced muddled thoughts or disorganized speech where others can't follow what I'm saying. It's more that I just feel blank inside, and my words tend to come out very short and flat.

Have you ever experienced any period where your behavior was clearly disorganized, such as wearing unusual clothing, acting in a way that seemed bizarre to others, or struggling with basic tasks like cooking or cleaning?
No, I've never really experienced anything like that. I don't wear unusual clothing or act in a bizarre way. I just mostly stay in my room and don't have the energy to do much of anything.

Looking back at the very beginning of your two-year struggle, did you experience a clear, initial period of active psychotic symptoms, like being very suspicious or having unusual thoughts, before the 'blank' feelings and loss of drive became the main problem?

No, it was actually the opposite. The blank feelings and losing my drive started first, right after I graduated high school over two years ago. The feeling that people were watching me and talking in code didn't start until just a couple of months ago.

When you have these thoughts about people talking in code, do you experience these as fleeting, suspicious moments, or do you have any persistent, elaborate, or bizarre delusions that dominate your thinking?

They don't feel fleeting at all; to me, these thoughts feel very real and persistent. For the last couple of months, I have genuinely believed that the church ladies and clinic nurses are pausing their conversations and glancing at me because they've been instructed to keep an eye on me. It really feels like they are constantly talking in code about me whenever I am around.
